import numpy as np
def reciprocal_residual(fn):
    coefficients = np.array([1.3 + 0.2j, 0.14 - 0.03j, -0.025j])
    original = coefficients.copy()
    inverse = fn(coefficients, 7)
    residual = np.convolve(coefficients, inverse)[:7]
    residual[0] -= 1
    return max(float(np.max(np.abs(residual))), float(np.max(np.abs(coefficients - original))))
assert np.allclose(reciprocal_residual(reciprocal_fourier), target)

import numpy as np
def boundary_residual(fn):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
    transfer = rng.normal(size=(3, 4, 4)) + 1j * rng.normal(size=(3, 4, 4))
    transfer[0] = np.eye(4)
    amplitudes = fn(transfer)
    incident = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
    outgoing = np.zeros((3, 4), dtype=complex)
    for degree in range(3):
        for coefficient in range(degree + 1):
            incoming = np.r_[incident if degree - coefficient == 0 else np.zeros(2), amplitudes[0, degree - coefficient]]
            outgoing[degree] += transfer[coefficient] @ incoming
    expected = np.column_stack((amplitudes[1], np.zeros((3, 2))))
    return float(np.max(np.abs(outgoing - expected)))
assert np.allclose(boundary_residual(scattering_series), target)
